plans.note: No limitation-of-liability heading in the outline; check the indemnity section (sec-12) and any trailing text in sec-8 for an embedded cap or damages disclaimer before concluding it is missing. Note the outline skips sections 3, 4, 6, 9 and 11, so a cap may sit in unsupplied text.

Section 12 (INDEMNITY) is the primary location. Test whether TrueLink indemnifies Client for third-party IP infringement and its own misconduct, or whether the indemnity runs one way from Client (sec-8 Client covenants/warranties and sec-7 e-mail obligations often feed a Client-side indemnity).
Watch for a restriction inside the licence grant (sec-2) or Client covenants (sec-8) barring Client from offering competing mortgage/web services; no dedicated non-compete heading appears.
Hosting deals often make the Host the sole provider of Hosting Services; check sec-2 licence scope and sec-8 Client covenants for 'sole and exclusive' language, and sec-5 for exclusivity-linked fees.
Only sec-5 (COMPENSATION) would carry pricing parity language; flag only if it obliges Client to give TrueLink its best terms rather than the reverse.
Non-solicits are commonly tucked into Client covenants (sec-8) or the confidentiality section (sec-10); confirm scope, duration and any general-advertising carve-out if present.

No term/termination heading in the supplied outline (numbering gaps at 3, 4, 6, 9, 11 suggest it may be unsupplied). Check sec-2 for revocation-at-will language and sec-5 for early-termination fees as proxies.
Term/renewal mechanics are not in the supplied headings; look for auto-renewal and price-uplift wording in sec-2 (licence term) or sec-5 (fee escalation).

No miscellaneous/governing-law section appears in the outline; treat as missing unless boilerplate follows sec-12 in unsupplied text. Preferred: NY, DE, CA or England and Wales with courts, not foreign arbitration.
No assignment heading supplied; check any boilerplate after sec-12. We need affiliate/successor assignment rights and no Vendor exit on our change of control.

Ownership will sit in sec-2 (LICENSE) with definitions in sec-1; confirm Client owns its content, customer data and site materials and that nothing assigns Client IP or data to TrueLink. Sec-10 may treat Client data as Confidential Information.

Sec-2 is the grant clause; test scope against affiliates and contractors, territory, and whether the licence is revocable at will or terminable only for cause. Sec-1 definitions may narrow the licensed materials.
Usage-audit rights, if any, would appear in Client covenants (sec-8) or alongside fee verification in sec-5; require notice, frequency limits and Vendor-borne cost if found.
Check sec-5 for late fees or stipulated damages and sec-7 (unsolicited commercial e-mail) for per-message penalties charged to Client, which would be liquidated damages against us.
The only warranty heading supplied runs from Client (sec-8); a TrueLink performance/service warranty appears absent from the outline. Also check sec-8 for a disclaimer of Vendor warranties.
No insurance heading; TrueLink hosts our site and touches Client data, so a standard insurance covenant should be added if none appears in unsupplied text.
Sec-5 (COMPENSATION) is the only place a minimum monthly fee, volume commitment or take-or-pay would appear; check for an exit if one exists.

No exit/transition heading supplied; sec-10 may require return or destruction of Confidential Information, which is a partial substitute but not data return in usable format plus migration assistance.
